note: Preferred: the post-ASC-606 element, and the one that excludes taxes collected for others.
Same concept including assessed taxes. One company, kept so the fallback is ordered rather than arbitrary.
The pre-606 total. Last because it is the least specific of the three.
Single tag, all ten companies. No fallback needed.
Result attributable to the parent. Preferred: it is the figure per-share calculations use.
Result including noncontrolling interests. Lifts coverage from 8 to 10; see the equity pairing rule in docs/concept_mapping_rationale.md.
Consolidated result, the scope operating cash flow is reported on. Used only against cash flow, in the earnings-quality metrics.
Fallback for the four companies that file no ProfitLoss. None of them carries a noncontrolling interest, so for them the parent result is the consolidated one.
Missing for one company. Derived where absent as assets - equity_incl_nci - redeemable_nci; the identity closes exactly. See the rationale.
Equity excluding noncontrolling interests. Chosen over the NCI-inclusive element on coverage: 10 against 7.
Not a fallback for stockholders_equity. Used only as the matching denominator when net_income resolves to ProfitLoss, and to derive total_liabilities.
Mezzanine equity: outside permanent equity but not a liability. Never a numerator or denominator on its own; it exists so the balance-sheet identity closes.
Single tag, all ten companies. The element excluding discontinued operations reaches none of them.
